name: Stage 13: Yngsviken to Djupviksängen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 13, Yngsviken to Djupviksängen.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Södertäljes kommun.

Yngsviken has official stage-start parking, but capacity appears limited in trip reports and OSM only weakly maps the parking geometry. Djupviksängen is an endpoint/access point, but stage 14 sources explicitly say there is no parking at the etappstart.

No strong direct public transport was verified at Yngsviken or Stora Envättern; Södertälje/Naturkartan context says public transport is missing there. For rail-based access, use connected stages or the 13:1 Gnesta and 13:2 Nykvarn connectors, which meet stage 13 at/near Djupsjön.

Closest practical bus context near the Djupviksängen/Djupviken side is Alsjötorp on the Läggesta-Laxne-Gnesta corridor, about 2.5 km west of Djupviken; it is not a simple trailhead stop and service can be sparse.

Stora Envättern reserve parking gives a useful side access/loop point from the road toward Römossen, and Friluftsfrämjandet describes parking on both sides of the road at Yngsviken. Recent Naturkartan context warns that access roads can be poor after nearby forestry traffic.

A toilet is mapped at Stora Envättern reserve parking by OSM/Naturkartan, while Länsstyrelsen text still says no toilet / construction planned or underway. Treat it as newly mapped or unverified until checked in the field.
Myssjö Gård is a nearby sponsored lodging/food context east of Yngsviken, but it is off the main Stage 13 line and should be shown as a detour service rather than a trail facility.
Källsvik 30 on the 13:2 connector has a stronger year-round tap, but it belongs to an optional Nykvarn connector rather than the core Yngsviken-Djupviksängen stage.
waterSources: Official water points include the spring after 2 km, the 13:2 connector spring north of Djupsjön, Stora Kvarnsjön, and Djupvikssjön. Treat all as natural/untested water even where OSM labels a point drinking water; the early spring and Stora Kvarnsjön are short side markers rather than pins directly on the walking line.
A July 2023 official trail comment said the last water source was completely dry, and blogs note some sources may not look fresh. Carry backup water even though several natural sources are mapped.
No treated tap was confirmed on the stage. Djupsjön and Fräkensjöberget are overnight nodes, not potable-water guarantees.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 15 km; Naturkartan agrees, while OSM relation 2390726, Äventyrligare, and AllTrails commonly measure about 14.5 km. Keep the official distance for planning and treat the measured line as approximate; OSM's geometry is useful but has stale/typo destination text.

For route drawing, use the official Yngsviken-to-Djupviksängen identity and the shared Stage 14 endpoint around 59.156016,17.228880. OSM relation 2390726 has a destination typo and mixed way-member orientation, so order geometry graph-wise from Yngsviken to Djupviksängen rather than trusting member order.

True wilderness stretch: steep climb from Yngsviken, easier forest toward Stora Envättern, then lakes, bogs, ridges, shelters, and reserve land. Recent reviews describe the first 10 km as demanding, rocky/scrambly, wet/slippery in places, and generally well marked.

Official warning: scattered bark-beetle damaged spruce can fall suddenly, especially in wind or bad weather. Stora Envättern and Holmsjöskogen reserve context repeats the warning, and some reviews report blowdown without treating it as an official closure. Avoid resting under dead spruce and avoid the route in strong wind.
Hiker reports and reviews describe wet, muddy, and slippery sections after rain, spring thaw, and late autumn; poles and waterproof footwear are useful despite the moderate official difficulty.
The stage passes through or near Stora Envättern, Holmsjöskogen, Lugnet, and Djupviken reserves. Reserve rules override allemansrätten; use prepared fire sites and check local restrictions.
Stora Envättern reserve: fires only at designated fireplaces, fishing prohibited, dogs leashed, no cycling except on constructed road, and tenting is limited to at most two consecutive nights.

Holmsjöskogen, Lugnet, and Djupviken reserve contexts prohibit damaging live or dead wood and protected flora. Holmsjöskogen roads are gated and access is best via Sörmlandsleden; Lugnet has no suitable parking. Holmsjöskogen allows only small fires from loose dry twigs where otherwise permitted, while Stora Envättern is stricter with designated fire sites only.

Djupsjön is the best verified overnight/service node on this stage because it combines shelter, fireplace, dry toilet/bin context, and branch access. Fräkensjöberget is the second key shelter/viewpoint node and has no reliable water at the shelter.

The 13:1 Gnesta and 13:2 Nykvarn branches connect at separate OSM nodes about 10 m apart near Djupsjön; show one route-builder hub but keep exact geometry nodes separate. Add those branches only once this part of the main route is selected. 13:1 has a June 2025 reroute near Frustuna/Jagbacken; 13:2 has the Källsvik tap and the spring north of Djupsjön.
General Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance says not to expect bins, but the Stage 13 maintainer note specifically mentions dry toilets and bins at Djupsjön and Holmsjön. Pack out trash regardless.

facilities.name: Yngsviken start/parking
facilities.description: Official stage start with parking. Trip reports suggest limited capacity, so avoid assuming a large trailhead lot.

facilities.name: Myssjö Gård nearby lodging/food
facilities.description: Sponsored nearby lodging/food context east of Yngsviken. This is off the main Stage 13 line and should be treated as a detour service.

facilities.name: Stora Envättern reserve parking
facilities.description: Reserve side-access parking near the eastern side of Stora Envättern/Römossen. Useful for local loops, but access roads can be rough after forestry traffic and exact public-parking geometry should be checked locally.

facilities.name: Stora Envättern parking toilet (verify)
facilities.description: Mapped accessible toilet at/near reserve parking. Treat as unverified/new because Länsstyrelsen text still says no toilet or construction planned/underway.

facilities.name: Spring after 2 km
facilities.description: Official natural spring/well area after about 2 km. OSM also maps drinking-water/well tags nearby, but quality is not guaranteed by the trail; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

facilities.name: Stora Envättern reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules include fires only at designated places, no fishing, dogs leashed, no cycling off road, and camping for no more than two consecutive nights.

facilities.name: Dead spruce / wind warning
facilities.description: Stage 13 and nearby Stora Envättern/Holmsjöskogen reserve context warn that bark-beetle damaged spruce can fall suddenly. Avoid the stage in strong wind or storms and do not rest under dead trees.

facilities.name: Stora Envättern north-point fireplace
facilities.description: Verified north-point fireplace/rest area by Stora Envättern, with lake water nearby. Reserve rules allow fires only at designated places and current fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Stora Envättern designated fireplace cluster
facilities.description: Cluster context for additional mapped fire/rest points around the north/east shore. Do not flood the map with every unreconciled fireplace pin until the UI supports clustered fire sites; use only signed/designated fireplaces.

facilities.name: Stora Envättern map-sourced shelter
facilities.description: OSM maps a shelter near the Stora Envättern entrance/parking, but official Stage 13 lists only Djupsjön and Fräkensjöberget as shelters. Treat as map-sourced rest context until field-verified.

facilities.name: Djupsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter and strongest overnight node on this stage; 13:1 and 13:2 connect here/nearby. Shelter-map data also notes tent context and unknown-quality natural water.

facilities.name: Djupsjön dry toilet/trash context
facilities.description: Dry toilet and waste bins are reported by the official stage-responsible note at/near Djupsjön. OSM has multiple nearby toilet nodes, so exact closest placement should be field-checked.

facilities.name: Djupsjön east dry toilet
facilities.description: Second OSM-mapped toilet near the Djupsjön service area. Official maintainer text confirms dry-toilet/bin context at Djupsjön, but exact closest toilet should still be field-checked.

facilities.name: Holmsjön dry toilet/trash context
facilities.description: Official stage-responsible note mentions dry toilet and bins at Holmsjön. Coordinate is OSM/context derived and should be field-checked.

facilities.name: Djupsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace at the shelter area; respect fire bans and reserve rules.

facilities.name: Djupsjön connector hub
facilities.description: Route-builder hub for the 13:1 and 13:2 connector branches. The exact OSM joins are separate nodes about 10 m apart, so keep branch geometry exact while presenting one add-branch choice to users.

facilities.name: 13:1 exact join to Stage 13
facilities.description: Exact OSM node where the Gnesta connector 13:1 joins Stage 13; use this for drawing geometry, not the nearby shelter/service marker.

facilities.name: 13:2 exact join to Stage 13
facilities.description: Exact OSM node where the Nykvarn connector 13:2 joins Stage 13; about 10 m from the 13:1 join.

facilities.name: 13:2 spring near Djupsjön
facilities.description: Official spring about 800 m north on the 13:2 connector; useful backup but about 550 m off Stage 13 proper, so show it as branch/continuation water rather than a main-route source. Seasonal reliability is uncertain.

facilities.name: Fräkensjöberget shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter and practical second overnight/rest node. Shelter-map data notes no water at the shelter; plan water separately.

facilities.name: Fräkensjöberget lookout tower
facilities.description: Lookout tower, view, rest, and fireplace context; OK Klemmingen is credited in local reports for the tower.

facilities.name: Fräkensjöberget fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace at the shelter/viewpoint area; Grillplatser reports two fireplaces plus a lookout tower nearby. Use only if fire conditions allow.

facilities.name: Stora Kvarnsjön water
facilities.description: Official water/rest point and OSM water marker near Stora Kvarnsjön; Länsstyrelsen Lugnet mentions cold spring water by the lake. Treat/filter and verify flow.

facilities.name: Lugnet / Viludden rest area
facilities.description: Rest/swim/viewpoint context near Stora Kvarnsjön; Gnesta describes several rest and swimming spots in Lugnet, especially Viludden via boardwalk. Natural water only.

facilities.name: Lugnet reserve / Stora Kvarnsjön
facilities.description: Lugnet reserve protects old forest and cultural-history remains near Stora Kvarnsjön. Do not damage trees, plants, or remains.

facilities.name: Lugnet no-parking caveat
facilities.description: Lugnet reserve has no suitable parking; reach it by Sörmlandsleden or water access rather than treating it as a trailhead.

facilities.name: Djupvikssjön
facilities.description: Water/rest point near the end; treat as untreated lake/surface water only. A 2023 official comment reported the last water source completely dry, so do not rely on this without backup.

facilities.name: Djupviken reserve warning
facilities.description: Djupviken reserve has steep old conifer forest by Djupvikssjön. Stay on durable ground and avoid damaging live or dead wood.

facilities.name: Djupviksängen end / no parking
facilities.description: Shared Stage 13 end / Stage 14 start node from OSM, matching the official Stage 14 start area. Official stage 14 information says there is no parking at the etappstart; informal roadside parking reports should not be treated as official.

facilities.name: Alsjötorp bus context
facilities.description: Closest verified bus-corridor context for the Djupviksängen/Djupviken side, about 2.5 km west via local roads/trails. Check Sörmlandstrafiken line 543/live traffic before relying on it.
